fields.Name: T223 - Resource Access Lookup Shows Grantees Or No Results
fields.Description: Exercises OnLookupResource -> PermissionEngine.GetResourcePermissions, which resolves WHO can access a specific (domain, resource type, resource ID) triple and renders the grantee table. This grantee-resolution path is distinct from User Access's per-user aggregation and from Audit Log's timeline.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the Permissions app via the application switcher next to the logo, then click 'Resource Access' in the left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Pick a Domain, choose or type a value in the 'Resource Type:' combobox, and enter any plausible identifier in the 'Resource ID:' field (a UUID-shaped string is fine even if it may not match a real record). Click 'Lookup'. Success is that the query RUNS and the surface shows one of two valid outcomes: a grantee table with columns Grantee, Type, Actions, Effect, and Expires plus a summary count, OR a 'No grantees found' no-results empty-state that echoes your query. Either a populated result table or the no-match state proves the lookup feature works.

judgeValidationCriteria: After entering a domain, resource type, and resource ID and clicking Lookup, the surface transitions out of the initial 'No lookup yet' state
The result is either a grantee table (Grantee / Type / Actions / Effect / Expires columns) with a count, OR a clearly labeled 'No grantees found' empty-state referencing the query
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
